elements.name: Barricade panel
elements.blurb: Blocks lanes. Brutes and Battle-wagons break it fast.

elements.name: Barbed wire (4 m)
elements.blurb: Slows zombies by 60% and deals 5 HP/s.

elements.name: Spotlight
elements.blurb: Reveals a 40 m cone and lets turrets see. Adds light Signature.

elements.name: Turret nest
elements.blurb: Auto-fires using ammo from the Scrap stock.

elements.name: Oil-drum trap
elements.blurb: Area damage; the drum makes a flame wall.

elements.name: Mine
elements.blurb: Area damage when something steps on it.

gasStation.name: Ruined Gas Station
gasStation.blurb: Pre-built walls, a canopy of cover and few build points.

flats.name: Open Flats
flats.blurb: Plenty of room, nothing to hide behind. Dust and light carry for miles.

canyonMouth.name: Canyon Mouth
canyonMouth.blurb: Rock walls on three sides. Choke points make it defensible.

carPark.name: Parking Structure
carPark.blurb: Concrete ramps and pillars. Loud in a city that listens.

plaza.name: Sunken Plaza
plaza.blurb: Wide open and echoing. Lots of room to park, lots of ways in.
